name: FortBox
tagline: A competitive 1v1 Roblox building-battle game with ranked matchmaking.
problem: The team wanted a fast building-combat game on Roblox.
solution: Grid building with three materials, editing, turbo placement and ELO-ranked matchmaking with stored player data.
demo_moment: Team-described: build a fort and battle an opponent.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 112 submissions.
Stores ranking data in the sponsor's database.

lessons: A familiar game mechanic needs depth (ranking, materials) to stand out.
